visual_findings: All seven isolated clothing layers show fabric only in the collar/neck opening; no obvious retained old skin patch, neck painting, old hair strand or unrelated object was found on light or dark flattened backgrounds.
The tan inner collar of style03 is a fabric design color and contains the same woven pattern as the collar; it should not be diagnosed as old skin solely from its hue.

Standing collar tips and dark fold lines are common to all seven. Relative to the newly softer face, the collars look sharper and more strongly outlined; this is a style/garment construction difference, not confirmed texture contamination or registration drift.

User localized two separate concerns: visibly ragged collar contours and unconnected neck/rear-collar tips. The latter is confirmed for all seven garments by per-row alpha measurements; outside-background connectivity does not excuse a required missing collar join.
limitations: Read-only visual review of PNG composition, not a new runtime import/cache check and not a claim that the user approves the clothing design.
corrected_conclusion: The collar/neck side gaps ARE a common visible assembly defect under the user requirement that rear collar tips meet the neck. The initial classification as normal raised-collar exterior space was premature.

runtime_layer_analysis.explanation: All current clothes are painted after the face, at the same full-canvas origin. Changing displayed rig guide coordinates will not alter the actual PNG join.

minimum_feasible_options.scope: Current fixed male face only, keep existing single clothing layer
minimum_feasible_options.action: Repaint collar-side connections and smooth ragged edges locally around y521..568. The visible new cloth contour must reach/overlap the current neck silhouette by a small antialiased margin, preserving overall canvas, body, garment style and front V. This needs no runtime code change, but only depicts visible rear-collar portions rather than a truly continuous hidden rear collar.

minimum_feasible_options.scope: Full continuous rear collar that is naturally occluded by face/neck
minimum_feasible_options.action: Add a paired rear-clothes support layer before face, keep front clothes after face, and link both to the existing seven clothing selections. The current one-layer-after-face pipeline cannot place an entire connecting rear arc behind the skin; unmasked insertion would draw cloth across the neck. This requires rendering/catalog/test integration, not merely a changed anchor coordinate.
